transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. To start, can you tell me what brings you in today?

I'm... just really tired. Like, the kind of tired that sleep doesn't fix. Even doing small things, like unloading the dishwasher or trying to read for this certificate class I'm taking... it just feels like too much.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess so. I just... I haven't really been doing much. Usually I like to sketch, or go to gallery openings, but lately I just don't care. Even cooking or yoga, or... playing tennis with my friend. I just haven't had it in me.
How long have you been feeling this way—tired and uninterested in things—has it been going on for two weeks or more?
Yeah... it's been longer than two weeks. Um... probably around three months, I guess. It's just been a long... quiet stretch. Just heavy and tired.
Have you noticed any unintentional weight gain or weight loss over the past few months?

Um... yeah, I guess I've lost a little. I haven't been trying to or anything, but... my jeans are definitely looser. I just... my appetite has been pretty off. Sometimes I'll realize I've only had, like, coffee and maybe a few bites of something all day.
Can you tell me about your sleep lately—are you having trouble falling or staying asleep, or are you sleeping much more than usual?
Um... I've just been sleeping a lot, I guess. It's hard to get out of bed. I don't really keep track, but... definitely more than usual.
Have you noticed being unusually thirsty or needing to urinate more often than usual recently?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't noticed anything like that. Just... normal, I guess.
Have you ever had a similar period of low mood, low energy, or loss of interest like this before, in the past?
Um... I don't think so. I mean... not that I can remember, anyway. Just... just recently.
Have you noticed feeling unusually short of breath, dizzy, or lightheaded, especially when standing up or exerting yourself?
Um... no. Not really. I haven't been doing much anyway, so... I don't know. Just normal, I suppose.
Have you been feeling unusually guilty, worthless, or down on yourself lately?
I mean... no. Not really. I don't... I don't really dwell on that kind of stuff, I guess. So, no.
Have you noticed that your fatigue gets significantly worse after physical activity or mental effort, sometimes lasting for a day or more afterward?
Um... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. Like I said, I haven't been doing much... so I wouldn't really know.
Have you noticed any heavy menstrual periods, or any other signs of unusual bleeding, such as in your stool or gums?
No... um, everything's normal. I haven't noticed any... bleeding or anything like that.
Have you or anyone else noticed that your skin, lips, or the inside of your eyelids look unusually pale lately?
No... um, I don't think so. I haven't really been paying attention to that, I guess. But no one has said anything to me about it.
Have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions lately, even with simple tasks?

Um... yeah, a little bit, I guess. Sometimes I'll just... sit with my planning app open and I can't decide what to do. Like if I should work on a class assignment, or pay a bill, or... start dinner. I just can't pick one, so I end up doing none of it for a while.
